g.text: bootwire flash app.bin: CONNECT, ERASE, WRITE, VERIFY, RUN
pad the image, check it fits the application region
2. ERASE every block the image touches
Strictly one request at a time. Any error status stops the update at once,
and RUN is never sent for an image that did not pass VERIFY.
Lost or damaged frames anywhere above are repaired by resend (see the fault diagrams).
